what_happened: Scene: layout 9, cream/silver single-pair toaster with the lever on its front-right, bread in the left slot. Stage 0: the gripper half-closed and pushed the lever down 144-160 (the bread dropped 5.5 cm with the carriage), toaster on 159-658. It stayed in contact with the toaster/lever area 163-503, then hovered. The lever rose 670-848 and stage 0 completed at 824 (online 832). Stage 1: 830-1520 the gripper hovered at the toaster's right end, touching the housing 803-899 and 943-993. The wrist view showed the bread sticking out of the far (left) slot about 15-20 cm away. The fingers opened 688-1040 and closed at 1025-1040 on nothing at the right end of the toaster, not at the bread, then stayed closed to the end. At ~1520-1560 the arm lifted, and from ~1600 the base drove away (1640-1800 in transit). By 1900-1980 the robot was at the dining counter with the closed, empty gripper right above the plate. The bread never moved from the toaster.
causal_chain: lever pressed correctly (160) -> pop-up done 824 -> hovered ~700 steps at the toaster's right end without reaching the bread in the left slot (one close on air at 1025) -> skipped the pick and drove to the dining counter empty-handed (1600-1980), ending over the plate -> bread still in the toaster at 2000
self_recovery: none: it never went back for the bread.
